successors.name: Scandinavian minor kingdoms
successors.text: Cliopatria's Norse shape of 490-499 (358 cells); 348 of them lie inside the Scandinavian minor kingdoms shape of 500

ledger.x: 184: the Norse shape reaches into inland Norway.

c. 200: Norway's first royal seat is founded at Avaldsnes. 'Norway's first royal seat was founded at Avaldsnes in c. 200 AD.' The year is the page's, 'c. 200'; the 25 km radius is the researcher's reading of a seat, not a boundary.
207: eastern Jutland enters the Norse shape.
402: the Norse shape grows from 16,295 to 71,171 km2.
499: Cliopatria's Norse row ends and the Scandinavian minor kingdoms begin.

certainty.note: No opened page gives a boundary, a ruler list or a polity for the Scandinavian Iron Age; every edge is Cliopatria's approximate outline and is drawn soft throughout.
